confirmatory_test.status: downloaded 21 Oct 2026, validated, hashed; no model evaluated on it
confirmatory_test.rule: processed and hashed before any model is evaluated on it; loaded only by scripts/paper3/confirmatory_test.py after the selection rule and selected configurations are committed and tagged
confirmatory_test.convention_check: MKM 180 vs LM 180 (training case): median differences 0.2-4 % of range, max 17 % (Pi12); no sign or unit error

not_searched.epochs: early stopping on inner validation, patience 200, max 5000

objectives.f_err: mean over inner leave-one-Re_tau-out folds of E_Pi on the held-out inner case
objectives.f_gen: max over the five inner folds of E_Pi(fold) / E_Pi_M0(fold), E_Pi_M0 = mean over seeds 0-4 (decided 20 Oct 2026). Largest on folds where M0 is most accurate (Re_tau 1000, 2000: about 0.02)
objectives.f_phys_A: 0.5 * rti / max(rti_M0, 1e-4) + 0.5 * coef_norm / coef_norm_M0 (rti_M0 = 0.00599, coef_norm_M0 = 3.578; floor 1e-4 approved 21 Oct 2026)
objectives.f_cost: matrix-multiply FLOPs per point, torch.utils.flop_counter.FlopCounterMode, float64, one point
objectives.aggregation: mean over seeds; seed SD stored
objectives.noise_level_for_ties: seed SD of M0 f_err over seeds 0-4 (0.0073), because one seed per candidate gives no per-candidate SD

qnehvi.implementation: src/ps3/qnehvi.py (deviation 1): qLogNEHVI, exact 4-objective box decomposition, 5 restarts, 256 raw samples, maxiter 100
qnehvi.startup_sampler: uniform random with the job seed (deviation 3); the QMCSampler passed in is not used for start-up trials
qnehvi.batch: sequential, q = 1 (changed from q = 4: one trial at a time keeps all strategies on the same evaluation schedule)
qnehvi.reference_point: BoTorch/Optuna default inferred from observed data (approved 21 Oct 2026)

selection_rule.feasibility: f_phys <= M0 value (Arm A: 1.0 by construction) and f_cost <= 2 x M0 (206556 FLOPs); Arm B also trace_rel_mean <= 1e-3 and rot_excess <= 0.01 (approved 21 Oct 2026)
selection_rule.choice: lowest f_gen among feasible; ties within the M0 seed SD (0.0073 on f_err) -> lower f_cost
selection_rule.refit: all five LM cases, epochs = median inner best epoch, seeds 0-9

statistics.bootstrap: Paper 2 paired hierarchical bootstrap, 4000 replicates, resampling optimizer seeds, refit seeds and 10% moving blocks
statistics.consistent: resolved, larger than the optimizer-seed range of both strategies, same sign on both confirmatory cases

reference_M0.note: Paper 2 TPE tuned with seed 0 only; seed 0 is the best of seeds 0-4 (winner's-curse evidence)

execution.storage: one Optuna SQLite study per job (results/paper3/search/<job>/study.db)
execution.sessions: background runs are limited to 2 h; a worker stops starting new trials after 100 min and the job resumes from its study in the next session
execution.interrupted_trials: a trial left RUNNING by a killed session is marked FAIL with user attr interrupted=true, excluded from the 200-evaluation budget and from analysis, and listed in the job log
execution.resume_seed: sampler seed on a resumed session = optimizer_seed * 1000 + number of trials already in the study (deterministic given the resume points; recorded in sessions.jsonl)
execution.failed_fits: non-finite training -> trial FAIL, counted in the budget, infeasible
execution.threads: one torch thread per job; two jobs in parallel on 2 cores

deviations.what: qNEHVI acquisition-optimisation budget reduced: num_restarts 20->5, raw_samples 1024->256, maxiter 200->100 (src/ps3/qnehvi.py); everything else as optuna_integration 5.0.0 qnehvi_candidates_func
deviations.why: optimizer overhead per proposal grew from 57 s (trials 21-30) to 219 s (trials 61-70) and was projected to about 20 min by trial 200, adding about a week of compute for 10 jobs
deviations.evidence: on the same 69 trials one proposal took 327 s with the frozen settings and 87 s with the new ones (3.8x; both under CPU contention)
deviations.effect: applies to all 10 qNEHVI jobs; the job started under the frozen settings (qnehvi__armA__seed3001, 69 trials) is rerun from scratch and kept in results/paper3/search_superseded/ as RQ4 overhead evidence only. Other strategies unaffected.
deviations.naming: the acquisition is BoTorch's qLogNoisyExpectedHypervolumeImprovement (qLogNEHVI, Ament et al. 2023), the log-scaled form of qNEHVI; this was already the case under the frozen settings via optuna_integration and is now stated explicitly

deviations.type: clarification of under-specified analysis definitions, fixed before any comparison between strategies was made
what: hypervolume: objectives divided by M0's values (f_err 0.06307, f_gen 1.166, f_cost 103278; f_phys Arm A 1.0, Arm B raw), reference point 2 in each normalised dimension (Arm B f_phys 1.0 raw); TPE trials scored on the same four objectives
selection-rule tie tolerance: 0.0721 = seed SD of M0's f_gen (the frozen 0.0073 is f_err's SD, written before f_gen became a ratio)

deviations.type: correction of a stated implementation detail (found after the seed-3001 qNEHVI jobs completed)
deviations.what: qNEHVI start-up design is NOT scrambled Sobol: optuna_integration's BoTorchSampler draws start-up parameters through independent_sampler.sample_independent, and QMCSampler.sample_independent falls back to RandomSampler(seed). The 20 start-up trials are therefore uniform random with the job's seed, identical to the first 20 trials of the random-search and NSGA-II jobs with the same seed (verified: identical configurations for seed 3001 in both arms).
deviations.decision: kept for all qNEHVI jobs (consistency with the two completed jobs). Effect: random search, NSGA-II and qNEHVI with the same optimizer seed share a common 20-point initial design; their hypervolumes at 20 evaluations are identical by construction.
deviations.note_2026_10_23: The shared initial design holds only while a job is not paused within its first 20 trials: a resumed session re-seeds the sampler (execution.resume_seed). In random__armA__seed3003 the first session ended after 14 trials, so its trials 15-20 differ from NSGA-II's and qNEHVI's for that seed (14 of 20 shared). All other completed seeds share all 20. Checked for seeds 3001-3003 in both arms.

deviations.type: scope change in later stages, decided before any ablation was run
what: secondary setting (TPE and NSGA-II on Paper 2's E1 interpolation folds) dropped

ablations defined and scheduled on Arm A, 5 optimizer seeds (3001-3005), 200 evaluations each, run after all primary jobs: A2 nsga2_nogen = NSGA-II (population 40) on f_err, f_phys, f_cost; A4 nsga2_nophys = NSGA-II on f_err, f_gen, f_cost; A3 wsum = TPE (10 start-up trials) on the equal-weight mean of the four objectives each divided by M0's value (f_err 0.06307, f_gen 1.166, f_phys 1.0, f_cost 103278)

every ablation trial is still scored on all four objectives; selection: A2 and A4 use the primary selection rule (so only the search changes), A3 takes its lowest scalar value (as TPE takes its lowest f_err)

The ablations test which ingredients of the multi-objective search matter (RQ2, RQ3) for about 50 core-hours.

deviations.type: Stage 2/3 redesign after a finding on training data only; decided before any conditioning-aware search was run
finding: Stage 2 frozen Reynolds-stress solve (src/ps3/rsm1d.py) verified with an anchored oracle (Pi_DNS - 3.6 eps (b - b_DNS)): converges in 4-5 Newton iterations on all five LM cases, J_R 1.0-3.5 % (DNS budget residual + finite-difference floor)

with learned and refitted classical closures the frozen solve does not converge: it is ill-conditioned. First-Newton-step amplification of the a priori error (frozen-k anisotropy problem, src/ps3/conditioning.py, LM 550 / 2000): published SSG 2.6 / 2.3, LRR-IP 0.9 / 1.0, LRR-IP+GL 1.2 / 1.3; six searched M4 candidates 8 to 59,000; the most accurate a priori candidate (f_err 0.051) about 15,500 / 19,800
the protocol's verification gate 'solver reproduces SSG or LRR reference profiles' was ill-posed (no such profiles exist for the frozen problem); replaced by the anchored-oracle gate above
what: Stage 3 solver-in-the-loop NSGA-II on J_U and J_R is replaced by nsga2_cond: NSGA-II (population 40), Arm A, seeds 3001-3005, 200 evaluations, objectives f_err, f_gen, f_phys, f_cost and f_cond
f_cond = mean over the five inner folds of log10(amplification) of the fold model on its held-out LM case (same split as f_err); capped at 8; a failed or non-finite diagnostic scores 8

selection rule for nsga2_cond: primary feasibility plus amplification <= 10 (f_cond <= 1); if no front member meets it, the front member with lowest f_cond; then lowest f_gen, ties within 0.0721 -> lower f_cost

for every strategy's selected model (all 50 jobs + M0 + classical references): amplification measured and the frozen solve attempted on each LM case and, once, on the confirmatory cases; outcomes (converged / not converged / diverged / non-realizable) reported, never dropped
queue order: primary, then nsga2_cond, then ablations
deviations.why: the planned solver objectives cannot be evaluated for most learned closures (non-convergence), while conditioning is cheap (one Jacobian per case), varies by 3-4 orders of magnitude between candidates and is the property that decides a posteriori usability

deviations.type: implementation details of Stage 3, fixed before any selected model was refitted or assessed
what: refit (scripts/paper3/refit_selected.py): selected configuration per job from analyse_search.select; all five LM cases, each case weighted equally; epochs = selected trial's median inner best epoch; seeds 0-9; M0 with Paper 2's 381 epochs (seed 0 reproduces Paper 2's training exactly: identical predictions)

classical references (scripts/paper3/classical_refs.py): SSG, LRR-IP, LRR-IP+GL, published and refitted on all LM (coefficients equal Paper 1's E2 refit), plus inner leave-one-out f_err and f_gen for the refitted forms

a posteriori on LM (scripts/paper3/aposteriori.py): amplification for all 10 refit seeds; frozen solve for seeds 0-2 only, at most 200 iterations (a non-converging solve costs 30-90 s per case); chosen from a timing test on M0 seed 0

interpretation rule: frozen-solve outcomes on a case are interpreted only if the anchored oracle converges on that case; on MKM 180 (not a test case) the oracle does not converge (stalls at residual 0.04 eps): its DNS budgets do not close to 13.6 % of eps in the outer region, against 1.3 % for LM 180. Conditioning (amplification) is reported on every case regardless
src/ps3/rsm1d.py: second-derivative operator handles grids whose last node lies on the centreline (MKM); LM grids end below the centreline and are unaffected (tests/paper3/test_final.py)

correction of wording: deviation 5's 'all 50 jobs' was written before nsga2_cond was queued; it means every completed job, now 55 (35 primary + 5 nsga2_cond + 15 ablations)
